title: The Battle to Break the局
next_chapter_hook: Ling Yuan watched from the shadows as Chen Ji reversed Heaven's Mandate, a sinister gleam flickering in his eyes before he silently merged into the Void. Meanwhile, in the Holy Sect's main hall thousands of miles away, a dormant consciousness stirred awake.

text.content: From the rift, ancient runes surged forth like a tide, each carrying an ancient pressure that churned the surrounding spiritual energy into a chaotic vortex. Chen Ji's pupils constricted sharply—that was no ordinary rune, but the true content of the fourth seal of the Tianji Record, a forbidden artifact capable of rewriting the cultivation world's万年 structure. Yet his gaze was completely drawn to the entity slowly descending from the other side of the rift. It was an eye beyond description, so massive it obscured half the heavens, with golden divine flames burning in its depths—like a lofty god, scrutinizing ants, overlooking this land that dared touch forbidden grounds.

dialogue.content: "An insignificant ant dares to covet Heavenly Secrets?" The voice did not come from any direction but resounded directly within Chen Ji's Mental Sea, carrying overwhelming arrogance. "Through ten thousand years, how many brilliant talents have attempted to peer into Heavenly Secrets, only to become skeletal remains on Heaven's chessboard. Do you think a fragmentary prophecy can reverse fate?"

text.content: Chen Ji stood motionless, his clothes billowing in the fierce wind, his features flickering between light and shadow. Only those perpetually calm eyes now carried a faint, barely perceptible smile. He did not answer the Heaven's Eye's interrogation but slowly raised his right hand, as an unprecedented rune appeared in his palm—the Eye of Breaking the局, the final gift passed to him by Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul when the fourth seal of the Tianji Record was unlocked.

The moment the Eye of Breaking the局 activated, Chen Ji felt the world suddenly change color. Everything in heaven and earth became transparent and clear—Heaven's Eye's massive form was no longer an unshakable divine marvel but a complex formation woven from countless light patterns; the annihilation light was no longer an inescapable heavenly wrath but an attack with clear trajectory and clear weakness. He could even see, deep within the golden divine flames, a minute crack slowly spreading—the hidden wound left by Heaven's Will forcibly devouring prophets through the ages, the fatal weakness buried within its ten thousand years of immortality.

choice.prompt: Heaven's Eye's annihilation light was about to descend. Chen Ji needed to make a choice in that split second—

choices.text: "Exchange life for injury, face it head-on"
choices.description: Burn one's own Heavenly Fate Value, use a broken body to hard-receive the annihilation light, seeking the sole counterattack opportunity in this deadly ground. Extremely high risk, but if successful, it would completely shatter Heaven's Eye's immortal golden body.
choices.visible_reward: Eye of Breaking the局 fully activated, can see through all of Heaven's attack trajectories
choices.risk_hint: A slight misstep means destruction of both body and spirit

text.content: Chen Ji did not dodge. He stood in place, forming seals with both hands, as the Heavenly Fate Value within him burned like boiling magma. The annihilation light slammed into his chest, the intense pain nearly tearing his consciousness apart—but at the same time, the Eye of Breaking the局 also completely awakened under the extreme pressure. An unprecedented light burst forth from his Brow Center, striking directly at Heaven's Eye's flaw!

choices.text: "Use wisdom to break force, borrow force to strike force"
choices.description: Use the Eye of Breaking the局 to see through the trajectory, guide the annihilation light to attack Heaven's Eye itself. This is the method of moving a thousand pounds with four两, minimal consumption, maximum gain, but requires extremely high control precision.
choices.visible_reward: Heaven's Eye injured for the first time, ten thousand years of dignity completely lost

text.content: A faint smile curved Chen Ji's lips. In the instant the annihilation light was about to touch him, he became a phantom, dodging that destructive beam at an unimaginable angle. Then, he formed seals with both hands, the Eye of Breaking the局 completely locking onto the beam's trajectory—and, using the enemy's method against the enemy. The annihilation light, guided by him, traced a perfect arc, striking directly into the depths of Heaven's Eye's pupil!

choices.text: Activate all seals of the Tianji Record
choices.description: Use oneself as a medium, forcibly activate all four seals of the Tianji Record from first to fourth layer, releasing the ultimate killing technique left by the first generation prophet ten thousand years ago. Once this technique is used, the existence of the Tianji Record will be completely exposed, inviting covetous eyes from the entire cultivation world.
choices.visible_cost: Tianji Record exposed, facing pursuit by the world
choices.visible_reward: Heaven's Eye severely wounded, unable to appear in the mortal world for a hundred years
choices.risk_hint: Kill a thousand enemies, lose eight hundred of one's own

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath and made a move that even made Heaven's Eye pause slightly—he pressed his palm against his own Brow Center, simultaneously activating the four seals of the Tianji Record. In an instant, the heavens and earth changed color, four distinctly different powers erupted from within him simultaneously, converging into a silver sword light capable of tearing the heavens, stabbing directly toward Heaven's Eye's core!

No matter what choice Chen Ji made, at the moment Heaven's Eye saw its annihilation light反弹回来, an expression of inconceivable shock appeared on that face woven from golden divine flames. Through ten thousand years, it had devoured countless prophets' souls, crushed countless heaven-defying beings' wills—never once had any existence managed to harm itself even slightly. And today, an ant in its eyes had achieved it.

dialogue.content: "You... what are you!" Heaven's Eye's roar shook the entire Void, and that originally domineering voice carried an irrepressible panic. "Impossible! How could a mortal peer through Heaven's operating trajectory! This is not prophecy, this is..."

text.content: "Not prophecy?" Chen Ji's voice remained calm, but the edge it carried made the surrounding air turn cold and biting. "Heaven's Lord, you've devoured so many prophets' souls, yet don't even recognize the Eye of Breaking the局? It seems even the so-called omniscient Heaven is nothing more than this." He paused, a mocking arc curling at his lips. "Or perhaps—your ten thousand years of immortality and dignity are all built on lies?"

The silver light of the Eye of Breaking the局 and the golden flames of the annihilation light collided violently in mid-air, erupting in brilliant radiance sufficient to blind golden core cultivators. The entire heavens and earth trembled violently at this moment, countless mountain peaks turning to dust under this collision of forces, rivers reversing their flow, the sky splitting open terrifying cracks. And at the center of that storm, Chen Ji stood with hands clasped behind his back, enduring the狂风暴雨般 impacts on his protective spiritual light, his gaze never leaving Heaven's Eye's flaw.

choice.prompt: Heaven's Eye severely wounded, letting out a fury-filled roar. Chen Ji must decide his next move—

choices.text: Pursue the victory, completely shatter it
choices.description: Press the advantage without giving Heaven's Eye any breathing room, use the Eye of Breaking the局 to lock onto the flaw, launch continuous attacks, attempting to completely shatter it in one fell swoop.
choices.visible_cost: Heavenly Fate Value consumption intensifies, may damage one's origin
choices.visible_reward: Heaven's Eye disperses on the spot, unable to reform for a hundred years
choices.risk_hint: Going too far may trigger Heaven's final desperate counterattack

text.content: Chen Ji did not hesitate in the slightest. The Eye of Breaking the局 coalesced once more, silver light like a venomous snake piercing through layers of divine flames, striking deep into the heart of that flaw. Heaven's Eye let out a shrill wail, its massive body convulsing violently, the golden divine flames beginning to dim visibly to the naked eye.

choices.text: Mock with words, collapse its will
choices.description: No hurry to attack, but use words to completely collapse Heaven's Eye's psychological defense. For ten thousand years it had been lofty and above all, today driven into a desperate situation by a mortal—this humiliation was the greatest damage.
choices.visible_reward: Heaven's Eye's Dao heart collapses, dignity completely lost
choices.risk_hint: Heaven may unleash a final desperate counterattack in desperation

text.content: "Ten thousand years of Heaven, suppressing all realms—so this is the quality?" Chen Ji's voice was unhurried, each word like a poisoned soft blade, brutally piercing Heaven's Eye's core. "I thought I might witness some earth-shattering abilities, turns out just this? So the so-called dignity of Heaven is nothing but empty吹嘘."

dialogue.content: "Presumptuous!" Heaven's Eye's roar carried irrepressible fury and fear, this originally invincible existence now appearing somewhat disheveled. "You ant, dare... dare speak to this Lord in such a tone! This Lord is the master of fate, the rule of all existence! You're merely a弃子 on this Lord's chessboard, what qualification do you have to mock this Lord!"

text.content: "Abandoned piece?" Chen Ji let out a light laugh, that smile carrying indescribable sarcasm. "Heaven's Lord, since you claim omniscience and omnipotence, why not calculate—if from the moment you decided to give the Tianji Record to me, you had already lost. You think you're the one setting up the board, unaware that I long ago planted my chess game within your chess game. Breaking the局, breaking the局—breaking not just the incomplete puzzle of the Tianji Record—but the Heaven's局 you've meticulously woven for ten thousand years!"

As the words fell, Chen Ji spoke no more. The Eye of Breaking the局 erupted with unprecedented light, a silver pillar piercing the heavens, striking directly into the depths of Heaven's Eye's flaw. That flaw expanded rapidly under the silver light's erosion, golden divine flames beginning to scatter wildly. Heaven's Eye let out a heaven-shaking wail, its massive body beginning to convulse violently, as if something was tearing it apart from within.

dialogue.content: "Impossible! This Lord is the master of fate! How could a mere mortal injure this Lord! This isn't real! This isn't..." The voice cut off abruptly, the golden divine flames suddenly dimming, and in Heaven's Eye's pupil, a pattern of cracks actually appeared—the wound that had never existed in ten thousand years, ironclad proof of Heaven's dignity being shaken by a mortal for the first time.

text.content: In the depths of the Void, a long-concealed aura stirred quietly. Ling Yuan's form hid within a twisted spatial rift, his features obscured by shadows, only those eyes—sparking an astonishingly sinister light the moment they saw Heaven's Eye injured by Chen Ji. His fingernails dug deeply into his palms, blood dripping slowly between his fingers, while in his heart, waves of scheming crashed like a tsunami.

"Chen Ji... just how deep are you hiding?" Ling Yuan's voice was so low only he could hear it, those eyes flickering with dangerous light. "Even Heaven's Eye can be injured—such a being, how could possibly be just atrash杂役? This old man has been setting up layouts for decades, thinking himself the true Chess Player of this Tianqing Sect... now it seems, the direction of this game likely escaped my control long ago." He took a deep breath, his form silently retreating into deeper Void. "Interesting... truly interesting. Since you lad hide such deep trump cards, let this old man see just what your limit is."

choices.text: Press the advantage, leave no future trouble
choices.description: Continue attacking, completely defeat Heaven's Eye, give it absolutely no chance for a comeback. Eradicate the roots, leave no hidden dangers.
choices.visible_cost: Self-consumption enormous, may fall into weakness

text.content: Chen Ji's gaze was cold and sharp, the Eye of Breaking the局's light coalescing once more. He gave Heaven's Eye no chance to catch its breath, silver pillars pouring down like rain, each strike landing precisely on that flaw. Heaven's Eye's wails grew increasingly mournful, its massive body shrinking rapidly, golden divine flames flickering like a dying candle in the wind.

choices.text: Know when to stop, preserve strength
choices.description: Today's battle results are already astonishing enough. Continuing the pursuit will only lead to mutual destruction. Better to know when to stop. Leaving a powerful enemy can instead spur oneself to continuously improve.
choices.visible_cost: Heaven's Eye escapes, hidden troubles remain
choices.visible_reward: Preserve strength, leave room for future layouts
choices.risk_hint: Heaven's Eye may recover and return with vengeance

text.content: Chen Ji withdrew the Eye of Breaking the局, stepping back. He knew he had done enough today—injuring Heaven's Eye, letting this lofty existence taste defeat for the first time—this in itself was already a miracle. Greed invites disaster, and could instead plunge oneself into an irretrievable abyss. He stood with hands clasped behind his back, calmly watching Heaven's Eye struggle in the Void.

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji!" Heaven's Eye's voice no longer carried its former dignity, instead带上了一丝嘶哑的怨毒. "Remember today's humiliation—this Lord will repay it a hundredfold! The day this Lord recovers full strength will be your death day!" Before the words even faded, that massive eye had already dimmed, turning into a shadow fleeing into the depths of the Void, leaving only those lingering threatening echoes.

text.content: Chen Ji stood in place, watching the direction where Heaven's Eye disappeared, a meaningful arc curling at his lips. "A hundredfold repayment?" he murmured to himself, his voice carrying indescribable mockery. "Heaven's Lord, today before all realms, you were injured by a mortal. Do you think you still have face to return for revenge?" He paused, a glint of scheming flickering in his eyes. "But never mind, I'll wait for you. The next time we meet, I'll let you understand what true despair means."

Ling Yuan witnessed all this from the shadows, his expression gloomy enough to drip water. That battle had completely overturned his understanding of Chen Ji. Thattrash杂役 he had always viewed as a chess piece, ready to be discarded at any moment, actually possessed the power to injure Heaven's Eye? What did this mean? It meant his decades of layouts might have been within Chen Ji's calculations from the very beginning. His hand unconsciously tightened, killing intent flickering in his eyes, quickly suppressed. No... now is not the time to make a move. Since Chen Ji is more dangerous than imagined, it requires even more careful planning. "Chen Ji..." Ling Yuan lowly called this name in the darkness, his voice carrying indefinable coldness. "You lad truly make this old man more and more unable to see through. But never mind, there's a long road ahead, we'll see who laughs last." His form flickered and vanished into the Void.
